METRIC_EXPLAIN.posture: How square and lifted your frame stays through the walk.
METRIC_EXPLAIN.pace: How close your speed is to this mode's ideal catwalk tempo.
METRIC_EXPLAIN.rhythm: How even and consistent your step timing is.
METRIC_EXPLAIN.footPlacement: How closely your head holds the runway centerline (a headset reads your head, not your feet).
METRIC_EXPLAIN.presence: Composite read: your posture, rhythm and pace weighted together, posture counting most. It is not separately measured - eyeline is not tracked.
METRIC_EXPLAIN.confidence: Composite read: pace, posture and rhythm weighted evenly with a lighter footwork share, plus a small settle-in credit that grows over the walk. It is not separately measured.
METRIC_EXPLAIN.presentation: Composite read: all four measured channels blended, posture and rhythm weighted heaviest. It is not separately measured - the turn is not analyzed.

METRIC_COACH.posture: Lift through the crown - shoulders back, chin level, ribs over hips.
METRIC_COACH.pace: Settle into one tempo - don't rush the start or drift at the mark.
METRIC_COACH.rhythm: Lock a steady cadence - equal time on each step, like a metronome.
METRIC_COACH.footPlacement: Hold your line - keep your head centered over the runway.
METRIC_COACH.presence: Presence is scored from your posture, rhythm and pace - lift the frame and steady the tempo and it follows.
METRIC_COACH.confidence: Confidence is scored from your measured channels - even out pace, posture and rhythm and this read climbs with them.
METRIC_COACH.presentation: Presentation rolls up all four measured channels - posture and rhythm move it most, so start there.

expect.CLEAN_WALK_CUE: Clean walk - every metric cleared the line. Step up a mode.

LIVE_CUE_TEXT.pace-fast: Slow it down - long, even strides.
LIVE_CUE_TEXT.pace-slow: Pick up the pace - stretch every stride.
LIVE_CUE_TEXT.posture-drop: Settle your height - smooth, no bounce.
LIVE_CUE_TEXT.posture-lift: Lift through the crown - chin level.
